summary.text: Thunder Junction is an American Wild West-inspired desert frontier plane favored by famous villains who travel there via Omenpaths.

bio.text: After the Omenpaths opened, the plane was overrun with outlaws, Riveteers built railroads, Ral Zarek built relay towers, and the Sterling Company kept the peace.
The opening of the Omenpaths also awakened the plane's wild magic, which settlers dubbed thunder.
Bertram Graywater founded the Sterling Company and wrote the laws of Thunder Junction.
An ancient vault, Maag Taranau, was discovered there, and Jace, disguised as Ashiok, hired Oko to retrieve its contents with a crew of outlaws.
Jace opened the vault and claimed Loot, a child whose mind holds a map of the Multiverse and every Omenpath endpoint, and he and Vraska escaped as the vault collapsed.
The great vault fell and scattered its wonders across the plane, and Oko's gang disbanded, with Kellan inviting Amalia to explore Thunder Junction.

status.text: Thunder Junction remains a frontier plane overrun with outlaws and kept in check by the Sterling Company, and it was last mentioned in 2026 as a plane Vraska and Jace considered bringing Garruk to.
